title: FTC ruling
text:
Looks like KeyRing has been investigated for their practices.  See their notice below: 
——
We’re contacting you because you used the mobile app Key Ring. InMarket, the app publisher, has settled with the Federal Trade Commission to resolve their allegations that we collected, used, and stored your location data without disclosing our marketing and analytics uses. As part of the settlement, we have changed our practices to provide consumers more control over their privacy choices.
 
What happened?
If you gave the app permission to access location data, InMarket collected and used your location data (including your exact physical location and movements) to provide app features. The FTC alleges that we also used and shared this location data with other companies for advertising purposes without your permission—for example, to target you with ads for a nearby drugstore or restaurant.
——

When you leave the list and go back, it defaults back to the sort by category.  I also don’t seem to have the history of what’s spent feature.  I don’t know if that has to do with the stores I shop or the app’s functionality.

title: Was simple now photos gone
text:
What happened guys?  All photos gonzo and now ads at startup diving nuts.  

Happy yo upgrade.  Help!!

title: What happened?
text: Can’t delete or save edits to existing cards. Is this app being maintained anymore?

title: Items Can’t Be “Checked Off” Lists
text: I used to love this app and used it every day. However, for the past couple years, I can’t remove or “check off” items from any of my lists. When I do, they continue to appear, essentially popping right back up as unchecked. This defeats one of the main purposes of the shopping list function which is a core feature of the app. I see other users have already pointed this issue out and yet it persists. Please, FIX THIS BUG so I (and others) can actually use the app again!

title: Pop-up Ads While Trying to Check Out
text: Love that the cashier is there waiting for your loyalty card and you’re tapping the X trying to get out of the ad and a browser opens whatever was being advertised and you flip back to the app and the X is now a spinning circle and you’re waiting, he’s waiting, people in line are waiting. And you can’t buy out of the ads so there’s no better future in store… going to look for another app. Maybe Wallet has that functionality. Hmm.

title: Why now?
text: You want me to rate your site.  I have not done anything with it.  I just opened up your site.

title: Cards deleted
text: I attempted to use my Key Ring. I guess it was updated since the last time I used it. All of my saved cards were deleted and I can not access my account. I never had a problem with the app until now. I no longer have some of my physical cards.

title: Privacy concerns
text:
The updated app requires you to accept cross app scripting. There is no option to decline. 
There is no reason this app needs access to my health, banking, browsing, and social media apps. Do not update.

title: Awful
text: Among other things, I can’t delete a card .  So I enter a new card and it mixes up card info.  Going to find another digital card carrier.

title: Keyring is awful. Don’t waste your time. It freezes constantly. Right now I cant even log in.
text: is awful. Don’t waste your time. It freezes constantly and right now i have been trying to get in it for hours.

title: Nice app but 2 much intrusion
text: Not pleasant to opt out of bombardment with associates, affiliates disclaimers and plethora of legal ease.  With the legal side costs for construct of agreements, disclosures and disclaimers it’s obvious US citizens personal info is more valuable than most realize.

title: Think long before getting this
text: I liked it at one time. Now I wish I would’ve never ditched some of my cards in favor of this. Most frustrating thing is have to click off a screen in order to access your cards. The last thing I wanna do is get a prompt when I’m at the checkout.

title: “Fetching Location Reminders” ruined it…
text: Was a great app, now when you finish shopping, launch this app at the checkout and surf to the store your at you get this annoying “Fetching Location Reminders” pop-up blocks the barcode and you just have to wait.  Sometimes it just won’t “fetch” and you dont get to use your loyalty card.  A lot of the stores around me seem to have poor cell signal inside and I dont usually go thru the trouble of getting on a stores WiFi unless I need it.  Please fix this.  I’m shopping around for a different app to use.

title: Not user friendly
text: Forced a review when just trying to check out

title: Stood for a minute at checkout
text: Twice recently I have been in line at the checkout trying to get my bonus cards or store cards to come up on this app and it’s updating location or something. I’m standing there waiting for this app to open and everyone is looking at me like what in the world is this guy doing. this app has 1 job. Deleted

title: Does the bare minimum barely well enough
text: Does this app successfully allow me to do what I need it for? Yes. But it is very annoying because every time I open it, I have to sit through a bunch of slow popups about privacy policy changes and asking me to review the app when I’m standing in front of a cashier trying to show him my rewards card. It’s just not the kind of app where you can pop things up to the user upon opening the app, and the fact that the developers of this app don’t know this indicates no thought has been put into the user experience.

title: Nothing in this app seems to work anymore.
text: Useless. Nothing in this app seems to work anymore.

title: New to Key Ring
text: I just created my account today on 11/16/23 and found that it wasn’t functional for me to use.  It wouldn’t pull up my list of cards I added back from several months ago.  It wasn’t even user friendly.  So I had to send a message to have them delete my account.  I thought it would be good to create a account since I had already added my cards and never created a account but not recommended since the new update was installed apparently.

title: Horrible!
text: Settings option has no use at all. None of the selections will open. Cannot update names on cards saved. Any revision at all says “not saved” this stinks!!!

title: This app has lost nearly all of its usefulness
text: The “Notes” function was erased without any advance notice. I had quite a bit of info there.

text: So I have to read the number out loud to the clerk each time. This is a pain.
